purpose: Source-backed nominal component references and explicit fit uncertainties; not an as-built scan or exact manufacturer assembly CAD.

board.identity: User-listed XYCJJCXL / Nextronics S2 Mini V1.0.0; geometry referenced to official WEMOS S2 mini V1.0.0 drawing and photos, not verified against the user's physical clone.
board.limits: No Gerbers, board layout, component BOM, or exact clone CAD supplied. Header grid, component placement, underside solder protrusion, antenna traces and corner/notch geometry are inferred. Do not certify fit from these meshes alone. Two existing mounting holes clamp the PCB. Two additional plain USB-end support strips contact photo-inferred bare underside areas; verify the actual board before tightening.

board_photo_envelopes.status: Positions and heights below are approximate from official WEMOS photos, not manufacturer package/assembly CAD.

switch.limits: Independently modeled external fit features from the drawing. Clip, light-guide, stem-height and pin shapes contain approximations. Not a Gateron STEP model; spring/contact internals omitted.

illustrative_plate_clips.status: Approximate engaged snap-latch geometry. Actual elastic deflection, latch dimensions and retention strength require the purchased switch and fit coupon.

keycap.part: MaxKeyboard Custom-Art-Keycap, OEM R3 1x1.5 Tab, white ABS
keycap.status: No exact vendor CAD or mechanical drawing found in product, profile, or download pages. Current 28x18x9 mm sculpted cap is an illustrative approximation, not verified against this SKU.
keycap.caution: Hollow illustrative cap and cross socket explain the press-fit mounting concept only. Socket dimensions, wall thickness and seating depth are unmeasured assumptions; not a replacement keycap STL or verified manufacturer fit. Internal nesting into the simplified solid switch housing is intentionally excluded from clearance certification.

illustrative_socket.status: Illustrative explanatory geometry; positive displayed cross clearance is not a production press-fit tolerance.

case_screw.part: Required M2x20 socket-cap screw; confirm this length is in the ordered kit or obtain separately
case_screw.limits: Kit head geometry unpublished; conservative nominal envelope based on standard supplier references. Measure purchased parts and print fit coupon. No threads, knurl or exact drive geometry modeled.

board_screw.part: Required M1.6x6 socket-cap screw; confirm this length is available
board_screw.limits: Kit head geometry unpublished; conservative nominal envelope. Uses existing 2 mm PCB holes without drilling; physical seating and component clearance require checking.

feet.status: Four trim-to-size feet moved clear of all four bottom screw-access bores.

wires.status: Pin mapping is verified from official pinout; insulation diameter, solder sizes and routed lengths are illustrative and must be checked after assembly.

usb_cable.status: Illustrative unmeasured cable/plug. These are clearance assumptions, not verified dimensions of the Adafruit cable listed in the BOM.

license_policy: No manufacturer CAD meshes or drawings embedded in the repository or Blender file. Models are independent nominal constructions with source links; dimensions do not establish permission to redistribute vendor CAD.

key_mount.retention: Upper flange carries downward load; two snap latches resist withdrawal; square aperture limits rotation. Purchased cap presses onto MX cross stem. No extra screws or glue.
key_mount.service: Remove case screws and lift lid to access switch solder joints and two latch faces. Release latches with switch puller; support switch when removing cap.
key_mount.limits: No structural load or extraction-force certification. Geometry preserves access but real FDM flex, switch fit and chosen cap seating require assembly tests.
key_mount.aperture_cad_compensation: 14.1 mm CAD is a print-fit starting point, not the manufacturer aperture dimension. Coupon choice must produce an actual 13.98–14.05 mm opening and 1.45–1.51 mm plate at the clip land.
key_mount.stabilizer: 1.5u Tab is unstabilized per Omnitype keycap size table; one centered MX stem.

reset_boot_service.mode: Lid-off access; no extra plungers or unmeasured external holes
reset_boot_service.limits: Use a narrow blunt nonconductive tool and adequate wire slack. Button coordinates and tool envelope are photo-based and not physically verified.

exposed_nuts.installation: All four screws enter from underneath. Board nuts rest exposed above the PCB, accessible with the lid removed; case nuts rest exposed above the lid. Hold nuts with a suitable tool while tightening gently. There are no restrictive hex pockets, covered seats or heat-set inserts.
exposed_nuts.limits: Kit length coverage and nut/head dimensions remain unverified. Confirm M1.6x6 and M2x20 lengths before assembly. Standard nut chamfers, full thread formation and actual tightening load are not modeled.

board_supports.status: Additional contact footprints inferred from official photos, not measured on the clone. Inspect for solder, switch anchors and components under each pad; do not force the board onto mismatched supports.

usb_opening.status: PROVISIONAL socket-hugging collar. Nominal0.2mm shell clearance. Standard USB dimensions do not guarantee the required actual fully seated cable shoulder gap. Test the registered fit cradle with your real board and cable before printing the case; never force a cable against the collar.
usb_opening.coupon_print_orientation: Actual PCB-registering cradle, upright USB wall and stepped port, four supports and two dedicated mounting-hole screws at assembly coordinates. Uses same2M1.6x6+topnuts.
usb_opening.source: USB-IF USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification Release2.4, October2024: Figure3-3(p54),Figure3-82(p147).
usb_opening.socket_visual: Independent rounded photo-derived outer9.2x3.2,r1.45. Standard nominal inner8.34x2.56 with illustrative r1.2. Not exact clone CAD.
